integrity: Proof and computations are supplied in full, with all parameters and normalizations; no claim of independent scientific certification or experimental validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform Markovian site-projector dephasing and complete-graph hopping; no site disorder, trap, amplitude damping, non-Markovian bath, finite-time mixing-tolerance optimizer or other graph topology. title: Exact optimal dephasing and inverse-size relaxation on complete quantum networks
